product: A council service for residents of Fernhollow: parking permits, penalty charge notices, appointments, documents and application progress, with an assistant that answers residents' questions on the page

actions.name: get_permit
actions.doc: The signed-in resident's current parking permit: permit number, zone, vehicle registration, start and expiry dates, and the price paid.

actions.name: renewal_quote
actions.doc: What renewing the resident's parking permit would cost: the lengths on offer with price and new dates, and what stays the same.

actions.name: renew_permit
actions.doc: Renew the resident's parking permit for 6 or 12 months and charge the card on file. Takes a payment.

actions.name: list_fines
actions.doc: Every penalty charge notice (parking fine) for one vehicle, newest first: reference, date, place, amount and whether it is paid.

actions.name: get_fine
actions.doc: A summary of one penalty charge notice (parking fine), found by its reference and the vehicle registration: what happened, when and where, the amount, the lower amount if paid within 14 days and its last day, and whether it is paid.

actions.name: pay_fine
actions.doc: Pay one unpaid penalty charge notice now with the card on file, at the lower amount while the 14-day discount lasts. Takes a payment.

actions.name: available_slots
actions.doc: Free appointment slots this week at one council office for one service: day, date and time of each, or none and the next free day.

actions.name: book_appointment
actions.doc: Book one free slot at a council office for the resident. Makes a booking; a confirmation email follows.

actions.name: application_status
actions.doc: Where an application is: its steps (submitted, checked, decision, permit sent) with dates, the current step and what it is waiting for.

actions.name: list_documents
actions.doc: The documents an application needs, which are already uploaded and which are still needed, with examples of what counts and the file types accepted.

actions.name: upload_document
actions.doc: Add a document the resident chose on their own device to an application. The assistant may offer this as a button; it never picks or sends a file itself. Changes the application.

actions.name: list_offices
actions.doc: Every council office with its address, opening hours, whether it is open today, step-free access and hearing loop notes, and any closures.

actions.name: office_details
actions.doc: A summary of one council office: address, opening hours, whether it is open today, access (step-free entrance, hearing loop, toilets), closures and phone.

actions.name: permit_prices
actions.doc: The kinds of parking permit side by side: who can get each, the price, the electric vehicle and blue badge prices, and how long each lasts.

actions.name: check_eligibility
actions.doc: A summary of whether someone can get a resident or visitor parking permit, from their address zone and vehicle type, with the rules that decided it and the price.
